title: Systems Thinking
summary: Understanding a phenomenon by examining interacting parts, relationships, boundaries, feedback, delays, and behavior that emerges at the system level.
definition: A system is defined for a purpose and boundary. Systems thinking examines how structure and interactions shape behavior over time, while recognizing that every system model omits detail.
learning_outcomes: Define a system boundary and identify relevant components.
Recognize feedback loops, delays, and emergent behavior.
Explain how changing a component may affect the wider system.
